task: Write a short update for my GP covering the diagnosis, the ibuprofen dose and timing, and what I have not taken.
text: Quick summary before I forget. I went to urgent care after my ankle swelled up on the hike. The doctor there said it was a mild sprain, not a fracture, and the X-ray showed no break. They prescribed ibuprofen 400 mg, one tablet every 8 hours, for 5 days. I think I'd been taking it for 3 days, no wait, 4, before the swelling started to go down. I have not taken any aspirin. The swelling is now roughly 2 cm larger than my other ankle. My sister, Aigerim Bekova, drove me there and has stayed with me this week to help.
